verses.2: Until then, let us wait and see. After that, we will discuss it further.
verses.3: Why are we considered like animals? We’re buried in front of your eyes.
verses.4: His soul will be taken away from him; he will leave this earth and be transferred to another place.
verses.5: Even the light of the wicked will be extinguished, and it will not shine again.
verses.6: Darkness reigns in his tent, and fire burns upon it.
verses.7: They will create an outline for it, and then discard its suggestions.
verses.8: For the serpent was sent with its feet, and it walks on its belly.
verses.9: It will hold onto the shadow, and it will strengthen itself on that basis.
verses.10: Tamun is in this land; his kingdom lies along the path.
verses.11: Around him were waters, and they spread out to his feet.
verses.12: May we be hungry, and may there be someone who can satisfy our hunger.
verses.13: He will eat in the days of destruction; he will eat his own flesh in the grave.
verses.14: He was taken out of his tent by force, and he was brought before the king in Balahoth.
verses.15: He will dwell in his tent, without anyone to harm him or attack him.
verses.16: From below their roots, they will be destroyed; from above, their harvest will be lost.
verses.17: He was lost from my land; there was no place for him on the surface of the earth.
verses.18: He was led from light into darkness, and from the sea he was driven away.
verses.19: He has no descendants, and I will not take care of his people. There are no survivors among his descendants either.
verses.20: On that day, the elders and the leaders will hold their doors together.
verses.21: But these are dwellings of evil people; this is a place that no one knows.
